To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RNN based LSTM is better than CNN and CNN LSTM in the speech emotion recognition task.
RNN based LSTM has the highest accuracy of 73.79%, followed by CNN based LSTM with 63.40% accuracy, and CNN with 57.59%.
the feature combination with the highest accuracy rate is the MFCC, Chrom, and Mel combination.

the classification of emotions from audio signals.
the development and implementation of an emotion recognition system that uses the features of MFCC, chroma and Mel to classify eight emotions.
the development of a new speech emotion recognition model using RNN and LSTM classifiers.
